people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: “Now, inhabitants of Jerusalem and men of Judah, please judge between me and my vineyard.
translations.bsb: “And now, O dwellers of Jerusalem and men of Judah, I exhort you to judge between Me and My vineyard.
translations.kjv: And now, O inhabitants of Jerusalem, and men of Judah, judge, I pray you, betwixt me and my vineyard.
translations.asv: And now, O inhabitants of Jerusalem and men of Judah, judge, I pray you, betwixt me and my vineyard.
